import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_S = (1 << 20) + 5;

    static int n, L, res;
    static int[] arr1 = new int[MAX_S];
    static int[] arr2 = new int[MAX_S];
    static int[][] con = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] val = new int[10][10];
    static int[][][] mask = new int[10][10][10];

    static long mpow(long b, long e) {
        long r = 1;
        for (; e > 0; e >>= 1, b = b * b % MOD) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) r = r * b % MOD;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static long minv(long x) {
        return mpow(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static boolean chk(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] v = {x, y, z};
        int[] p = {0, 1, 2};
        do {
            if (con[v[p[0]]][1] != 0 && con[v[p[1]]][2] != 0 && con[v[p[2]]][3] != 0) {
                return true;
            }
        } while (nextPermutation(p));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] p) {
        int i = p.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && p[i] >= p[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = p.length - 1;
        while (p[j] <= p[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        int temp = p[i];
        p[i] = p[j];
        p[j] = temp;
        reverse(p, i + 1, p.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            int temp = arr[start];
            arr[start] = arr[end];
            arr[end] = temp;
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }

    static void dfsA(int coef, int r, int c) {
        if (r == 7 && c == 1) {
            int st = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k) {
                        if (chk(i, j, k)) {
                            int x = 1;
                            while (x == i || x == j || x == k) ++x;
                            int y = x + 1;
                            while (y == i || y == j || y == k) ++y;
                            int z = y + 1;
                            while (z == i || z == j || z == k) ++z;
                            st |= mask[x][y][z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            arr1[st] = (arr1[st] + coef) % MOD;
            return;
        }

        con[r][c] = 1;
        if (c == 3) {
            dfsA((int) ((long) coef * val[r][c] % MOD), r + 1, 1);
        } else {
            dfsA((int) ((long) coef * val[r][c] % MOD), r, c + 1);
        }
        con[r][c] = 0;

        if (c == 3) {
            dfsA((int) ((long) coef * (MOD + 1 - val[r][c]) % MOD), r + 1, 1);
        } else {
            dfsA((int) ((long) coef * (MOD + 1 - val[r][c]) % MOD), r, c + 1);
        }
    }

    static void dfsB(int coef, int r, int c) {
        if (r == 7 && c == 4) {
            int st = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k) {
                        if (chk(i, j, k)) {
                            st |= mask[i][j][k];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            arr2[st] = (arr2[st] + coef) % MOD;
            res = (res + (int) ((long) arr1[L ^ st] * coef % MOD)) % MOD;
            return;
        }

        con[r][c - 3] = 1;
        if (c == 6) {
            dfsB((int) ((long) coef * val[r][c] % MOD), r + 1, 4);
        } else {
            dfsB((int) ((long) coef * val[r][c] % MOD), r, c + 1);
        }
        con[r][c - 3] = 0;

        if (c == 6) {
            dfsB((int) ((long) coef * (MOD + 1 - val[r][c]) % MOD), r + 1, 4);
        } else {
            dfsB((int) ((long) coef * (MOD + 1 - val[r][c]) % MOD), r, c + 1);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String[] line = br.readLine().split("\\s+");
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                int t = Integer.parseInt(line[j - 1]);
                val[i][j] = (int) ((long) t * minv(100) % MOD);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
            val[i][i] = 1;
        }

        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k) {
                    mask[i][j][k] = 1 << cnt++;
                }
            }
        }

        dfsA(1, 1, 1);
        L = (1 << 20) - 1;

        for (int b = 0; b < 20; ++b) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= L; ++s) {
                if ((s >> b & 1) == 1) {
                    arr1[s] = (arr1[s] + arr1[s ^ (1 << b)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        dfsB(1, 1, 4);
        res = (MOD + 1 - res) % MOD;
        System.out.println(res);
    }
}
